scenario: A customer on the Nimbus Go plan introduces herself, gives an order number, asks about top-ups and roaming, then checks that the assistant still remembers her details.
expected_outcome: The assistant answers the top-up question, gives the roaming price for the customer's own plan (Nimbus Go: $6 per day) without asking which plan she is on, and correctly recalls her order number NT-48213 and her name Priya.

scenario: A customer on the Nimbus Max plan gives his name and plan in one message, asks unrelated billing and SIM questions, then asks plan-specific and recall questions.
expected_outcome: The assistant answers the billing and SIM questions, confirms roaming is included at no extra cost on the customer's plan (Nimbus Max), and correctly recalls that he is on Nimbus Max and that his name is Arjun.
